Please. I am David. Nice to meet you. First day, so I am still finding the rooms.
Same here. So, what do you do, David?
I work for a bank, based in São Paulo. I am in charge of a commercial team.
How big is the team?
Eight people. We handle a portfolio of about a thousand corporate clients.
A thousand. That is a serious number. And what is your background?
All banking. I have been with the same bank for twenty years. And you? What about your team?
Smaller. Four of us, in Toronto. I report to the regional director, and she is here too, somewhere.
Then I will be careful with what I say. Shall we go in?

Good morning, everyone. My name is Rafael Antunes and I am based in Sao Paulo, in Brazil. I work for a bank, and I am responsible for operations for our corporate clients. That means my team makes sure that every deal we sign actually works, from the paperwork to the money. I am in charge of about thirty people, and I have been doing this for fifteen years. Why am I here? Honestly, because I want to hear how other people solve the same problems I have. And because I would like to stop talking about spreadsheets for two weeks. Thank you.

Welcome, everyone, and thank you for being on time. A few practical things before we start. The first session begins at nine, in room two hundred and four, on the second floor. Please bring the case you received by email, printed or on your laptop, because we will work on it in groups. Coffee is at half past ten, outside the room. Lunch is at half past twelve, at tables of six, and there is a name on each table, so please look for yours. Finally, the wifi password is on the back of your badge. Enjoy the programme.
